core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hannan corresponds to the Arabic form حنان (Arabic root ح ن ن (ḥ-n-n); حَنَّان (Ḥannān)). Its core sense is grace, beauty, compassion. Hannan is Arabic حَنَّان (Ḥannān) 'very compassionate, most tender', an intensive form from the root ح ن ن (ḥ-n-n). It is a divine name. The source gloss 'graceful, beautiful, or pleasing' is a loose rendering; 'compassionate, tender' is the lexical sense. Used for both men and women. Same name as hanan and hanaan.

faq.q: What is the origin of Hannan?
faq.a: Hannan is associated with Arabic. Hannan is Arabic حَنَّان (Ḥannān) 'very compassionate, most tender', an intensive form from the root ح ن ن (ḥ-n-n). It is a divine name. The source gloss 'graceful, beautiful, or pleasing' is a loose rendering; 'compassionate, tender' is the lexical sense. Used for both men and women. Same name as hanan and hanaan.
Yes — the underlying form حنان is Arabic.

faq.a: In Urdu, Hannan is rendered حنان and carries the sense فضل، حسن، شفقت.

faq.q: What does Hannan mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Hannan is rendered حنان and carries the sense لطف، زیبایی، دلسوزی.
A romanized syllable approximation is han-nan. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Hannan?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Hannan, hannan. Script forms are حنان, हन्नान.

faq.q: Is Hannan a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as unisex. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
